text_block_list.text:
With post time drawing near, Air Groove 
was uncharacteristically staring at her 
smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...It looks like Dober has arrived at the 
venue. I just got a message from her."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I must show her. This challenge of mine.

I can feel Air Groove's fighting spirit 
surging. All that's left now is to believe 
in her and send her out there...!
